{
 "title": "Implement and verify motif-copy rule",
 "command": "cat > programs/task-39765708.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker = min((v for v in counts if v not in (0, 8, 2)), default=None)
    # The motif color is the rare non-background color distinct from the two field colors.
    if marker is None:
        candidates = [(n, v) for v,n in counts.items() if v not in (0,8) and n < h*w//2]
        if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
        marker = min(candidates)[1]
    positions = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    if not positions: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in positions); r1=max(r for r,c in positions)
    c0=min(c for r,c in positions); c1=max(c for r,c in positions)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in positions}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Copy the colored-cell mask to every placement whose mask falls entirely on field zeros.
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0)):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0)):
            if (r,c)==(r0,c0): continue
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr,cc in cells):
                for rr,cc in cells: out[rr][cc]=marker
    return out
PY
